In March 2012, AIG's Board of Directors authorized the repurchase of shares of common stock of AIG, par value $2.50 per
share (AIG Common Stock), with an aggregate purchase amount of up to $3 billion from time to time in the open market, private purchases, through derivative or automatic purchase contracts or
otherwise. This authorization replaced all prior AIG Common Stock repurchase authorizations. 

In
March 2012, the Department of the Treasury, as the selling shareholder, closed the sale of 206,896,552 shares of AIG Common Stock, at an initial public offering price of $29.00 per
share (the Offering). AIG purchased shares of AIG Common Stock in the Offering for an aggregate purchase amount of $3.0 billion, utilizing the authorization in full. 

The following table sets forth the information with respect to purchases made by or on behalf of AIG or any "affiliated purchaser" (as defined in Rule 10b-18(a)(3) under
